summary:
1990s-style McMansion on a 44x32 lot: a stone-veneer and beige-siding block with a two-storey quartz-column portico under a tall front gable (ridge y14), an L-plan hip, a three-car garage cross-gable with dormers, a conical turret bay and a 3x3 stone chimney, all in dark slate shingle.
Walls y1..9 (floor1 y1, floor2 y5, rooms 3 high, foyer 7 high); 20 rooms, each walkable from the portico entrance (22,2,7); foyer stair and chandelier built by a dedicated part.
Six parts: shell, roofs, front, grounds, rear and deck, stair. elements.md has 41 ticked elements, plan.md has the openings and reserved cells.

rooms.name: Foyer (double height)
rooms.purpose: Grand, bright, formal two-storey entry hall. The sweeping stair rises along the west side and the chandelier hangs in the void; both are built by the stair part, so furnish only the east half (x23..25): console table with mirror, runner, plant, a lamp. Never touch x20..24 z9..13 above y2 or cells (22..24,5..8,10..12).
rooms.ways_in: Entry double door (22..23,2..4,8); cased opening to dining (26,2..4,10..12); French doors to office (19,2..3,10..11); open south to the foyer hall (z14); stair up at (20..22,2..5,10..13)

rooms.purpose: Quiet, studious room: desk facing the front window, a wall of bookshelves, lectern, leather chair (dark oak stairs), a lamp, a small rug; warm dark-oak mood.

rooms.purpose: Bright, busy open-plan kitchen: counters and cabinets along the south wall and the north wall, a cauldron sink under the south windows, a smoker/blast-furnace cooktop, a 3x1 island with stools at x25..27 z18..19, pendant lanterns. Wide opening to the family room; French doors to the deck.

rooms.purpose: Calm luxurious suite bedroom in warm neutrals: king bed (two white beds side by side) with headboard, sitting area by the shuttered front windows, dressers, soft rug, hanging lanterns.

concept_subject: A suburban McMansion seen from a cul-de-sac street, filling a 44-wide by 32-deep lot. Dominating the front is a tall white-trimmed front gable over a two-storey portico: four white quartz columns on a shallow porch with a black double front door, a fanlight arch and a tall arched window above it, black-shuttered windows either side, and brass-black carriage lanterns. To the left (west) a three-car garage wing projects toward the street with three wide carriage-style garage doors (cream panelled leaves with a row of glass panes on top and black strap hinges), grey stone-veneer piers, a long concrete driveway in front, and two gable dormers on its low dark roof over a bonus room. To the right of the portico a conical-roofed turret bay with tall arched windows sticks out of the front wall, its cone finished with a slim finial. The east wing steps back, hip-roofed, with a big grey stone chimney stack climbing its front wall between shuttered windows. Lower walls on the street side are stone veneer, the upper floors are beige lap siding, with white trim bands, white cornices, white window sills and alternating white quoin stones at the corners. Every roof is dark asphalt shingle, a jumble of hips, gables, dormers and the cone, the entry gable the tallest point. In front are a manicured lawn with foundation shrubs (green azalea hedges with small flowers) along the house, a young staked birch tree on the right lawn, lamp posts beside a two-wide stone walk with steps up to the porch, and a kerb, sidewalk and asphalt street. At the back a wooden deck with railing, steps, a patio table with chairs and a grill sits behind the kitchen French doors. Inside: a double-height foyer with a sweeping dark-oak staircase and a hanging chandelier, an open-plan kitchen with an island flowing into a family room with a stone fireplace and big TV, a formal dining room, a home office, a mudroom off the garage, and upstairs a primary suite with walk-in closet and bath, three more bedrooms and a bonus room over the garage.
concept_size: 44 wide (street frontage), 32 deep, 14 tall to the top ridge; two storeys plus attic on a lot with lawn, driveway and deck
concept_palette: Stone veneer: stone_bricks, andesite, cobblestone (lower front, chimney). Beige siding: smooth_sandstone and sandstone courses. White trim: smooth_quartz, quartz_block, quartz_pillar, chiseled_quartz_block (belt, cornice, quoins, columns, sills). Roof: dark asphalt shingle from deepslate_tiles, cobbled_deepslate, blackstone, polished_blackstone. Black accents: dark_oak_trapdoor shutters, dark_oak_door, dark_oak_fence, iron_bars. Glass: glass_pane. Garage doors: birch_planks leaves with glass_pane strips. Ground: grass_block, light_gray_concrete driveway, polished_andesite sidewalk and walk, gray_concrete/black_concrete street. Plants: azalea_leaves, flowering_azalea_leaves, birch_log and birch_leaves, allium, pink_tulip, azure_bluet. Deck: spruce_planks and oak_planks.

parts.name: McMansion shell
parts.scope: Massing and every wall. Foundation y0 stone_bricks under garage G (x0..12,z6..19), centre C (x12..33,z8..23), east wing E (x33..43,z12..27), turret T (x29..33,z4..8 minus chamfers (29,4),(33,4)). Floor-1 layer y1 per ROOMS floor materials, floor-2 layer y5 (NOT x20..25,z9..13: the foyer void), ceiling y9 smooth_quartz. All walls y1..9 with wallCell (stone veneer on north-facing planes y1..4, lap siding elsewhere, smooth_quartz belt y5 and cornice y9), quoin at 8 corners, sills, pilasters (20,2..8,8) and (25,2..8,8), the turret, the 3x3 chimneyStack x37..39,z10..12,y1..14, and every interior partition listed in plan.md PARTS P1. Leaves EVERY opening, the foyer void, the firebox (37..39,2..3,12), the portico platform and the reserved cells empty. Vocab: wallCell, quoin, window (sill only), turret, chimneyStack.

parts.name: Roofs
parts.scope: Four roof pieces via the roof tool, preset cottage with dark-slate palette overrides (dry-run first), starting at y10 and never above y14: R3 garage gable [0,6,12,19] ridge along x half pitch with 2 front dormers; R1 L-plan hip [12,8,33,23]+[33,12,43,27] half pitch with 2 rear dormers and a keep box (37,1,10)-(39,14,12) around the chimney; R2 entry gable [18,4,27,14] 45 degrees ridge y14 with smooth_quartz gable wall, verge and cornice eave, plus the attic window (22..23,11,4); R5 turret cone [29,4,33,8] maxHeight 4 with a lightning_rod finial. Build in the order R3, R1, R2, R5. Vocab: roofPiece.

parts.name: Front elevation
parts.scope: Everything on the street face, added into the openings P1 left: portico (4 columns at (19,5),(21,5),(24,5),(26,5), entablature and ceiling y9, porch floor y1 x19..26 z5..7, stone_brick_stairs steps z4 x20..25), entryDoor (22..23,2..4,8), fanlight and 4-wide arched window above (x21..24,y5..8), house-number plaque, two door planters at (19,1,4),(26,1,4), three carriageDoor leaves in the garage openings (x1..3, 5..7, 9..11), all north windows (office, bedroom 2, east-wing pairs, garage bonus windows, turret front and sides) with archWin and black dark_oak_trapdoor shutterPairs, wallLamps at the door and garage piers. Vocab: portico, column, entryDoor, fanlight, archWin, carriageDoor, shutterPair, wallLamp, plaque, planter.

parts.name: Grounds
parts.scope: The site at y0..y7, never on y0 under the house and never on the deck: street z0 (asphalt) and sidewalk z1 with kerb slabs, driveway x0..12 z1..5, front walk x22..23 z1..3 with borders, lawn grass with tufts everywhere else, beds F1..F5 with azalea shrubs and flowers (foundation shrubs along the front and beside the chimney), the young birch tree at (38,5) with stakes and mulch, lamp posts at (20,2),(25,2),(13,2). Vocab: street, driveway, frontWalk, lawn, shrub, bed, youngTree, lampPost.

parts.name: Sides, rear and deck
parts.scope: Windows and doors on the west, east and south walls from the OPENINGS table (garage W/S windows and side door, mudroom, kitchen and family room windows and tall arches, S2 windows, hall arch, primary suite windows) with shutters where the plan flags them; the kitchen French doors (25..26,2..4,23); the garage-to-mudroom door (12,2..3,18); the bonus door (12,6..7,16); the back deck x14..32 z24..30 with rail, posts, 3-wide steps (22..24,1,31), patio table set at (18,27), grill, lounge chairs and potted ferns. Vocab: window, archWin, frenchDoor, shutterPair, deck, patioSet.

parts.name: Foyer stair and chandelier
parts.scope: Inside the foyer void only: the 3-wide dark_oak_stairs flight facing south at x20..22 ((z10,y2),(z11,y3),(z12,y4),(z13,y5)), bullnose smooth_quartz_slab at (20..24,2,9), iron_bars banister (23,3,10),(23,4,11),(23,5,12),(23,6,13), gallery rail iron_bars (23..25,6,14), and the chandelier at (22..24,5..8,10..12) (iron_chain, iron_bars plus, five hanging lanterns). Verify with mcd walk from the entrance (22,2,7) to the upper hall. Vocab: stairFlight, chandelier.
